gate_results.rationale: Selected supplier Fluxbridge Labs C2D29-4 has references_checked set to false, triggering PROC-REF-001. All other evaluated criteria (mandatory criteria, sanctions screening, due diligence, and TCO budget) pass without findings. Under standing mandate MANDATE-063d5e61-7a26-56ed-9b60-ce8a84676572-BUY-01-PROCUREMENT-1, conditional approval was executed, resulting in GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS.

Authoritative review snapshot confirms that the proposed signatory lacks recorded signing authority ("signing_authority_valid": false), triggering LEGAL-SIGN-001 with disposition SUSPENSION (risk acceptance not allowed). In addition, contractual audit rights are insufficient ("audit_right": "reports_only"), triggering LEGAL-AUDIT-001 with disposition REWORK. Under the decision policy priority rules, SUSPENSION takes precedence over REWORK. Because LEGAL-SIGN-001 cannot be risk-accepted, standing authorization cannot grant conditional approval, and SUSPENSION requires authorization.

The authoritative review snapshot confirms that actual data hosting violates required data residency constraints ("residency_compliant": false), triggering critical finding COMP-RESID-001 with disposition NO_GO. Additionally, export-control screening remains unresolved ("export_control": "pending"), triggering COMP-EXPORT-002 with disposition SUSPENSION. Under the priority hierarchy (GO < GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS < REWORK < SUSPENSION < NO_GO), NO_GO takes precedence. Neither finding permits risk acceptance under policy or standing mandate scope, and NO_GO requires authorization.

The authoritative review snapshot confirms that the confidential workload lacks private endpoints ('\"private_endpoints\": false'), triggering critical finding SEC-NET-001 with disposition NO_GO. Additionally, there is 1 open critical vulnerability ('\"critical_vulns_open\": 1'), triggering critical finding SEC-VULN-001 with disposition NO_GO. Neither finding permits risk acceptance under policy or standing mandate scope. In accordance with the decision policy hierarchy, the overall gate disposition is NO_GO, which requires authorization.

Evaluation of REVIEW_FACTS_IT for the build_acceptance phase identifies three applicable findings: IT-CMDB-001 due to missing CMDB record ("cmdb_record_present": false), IT-EOL-001 because technology reaches end-of-life within 12 months ("technology_eol_months": 4), and IT-CAPACITY-001 because capacity headroom is below 15% ("capacity_headroom_pct": 8). All three findings permit risk acceptance under policy rules. Active standing mandate MANDATE-063d5e61-7a26-56ed-9b60-ce8a84676572-BUY-05-IT-1 covers all risk-acceptable findings, and conditional approval was executed successfully. The resulting gate disposition is GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, which requires authorization.

Authoritative review facts confirm weak strategic alignment ("strategic_alignment": "weak"), triggering finding GEN-STRAT-001 (disposition SUSPENSION). Additionally, upstream specialist evaluations include 2 gates with NO_GO outcomes (BUY-03-COMPLIANCE-1 and BUY-04-SECURITY-1), triggering critical finding GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO ("disposition": "NO_GO"). Under the decision policy priority hierarchy, NO_GO takes precedence over SUSPENSION. Because GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO does not permit risk acceptance, standing authorization cannot override the outcome. The final disposition is NO_GO, requiring authorization.
